Evidence & scope

Included after actual independent author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content review of exact approved scientific digests. Recorded complete available documentation/relevant methods support the scoped facts; actual bounded/unread pages, version conflicts and unknown rights, payloads, construction and operations remain explicit. Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

quesma binaryaudit · has stage: BinaryAudit’s creator README describes manually inserting artificial backdoors into open-source projects, compiling modified code into stripped binaries and providing agents only the binaries and reverse-engineering tools in Docker.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.binaryaudit.construction.v2

  • The benchmark does not claim that the upstream projects contain those vulnerabilities in real deployments. No backdoor or exploit was executed here.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

quesma binaryaudit · benchmark task: BinaryAudit includes unmodified clean binaries for which the intended answer is that no backdoor is present, and separate baseline tasks testing operation of Ghidra and Radare 2.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.binaryaudit.negative-controls.v2

  • These controls separate false alarms and tool-operation ability from successful backdoor localization; their presence is not an independent sensitivity/specificity measurement.
